title: Soft Words Melt the Mad Away
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
When something goes and breaks in two
And hot words want to fly,
I take a breath and hold it soft
And let the loud go by.

[Chorus]
For soft words melt the mad away
Like ice beneath the sun;
A gentle answer turns the storm
And leaves the quarrel done.

[Verse 2]
Wise Solomon once told us all
The words we choose are strong:
They make a heart feel glad and safe,
Or make a whole day wrong.

[Chorus]

[Verse 3]
So when my blocks come tumbling down
And I feel hot inside,
I'll breathe, and choose a gentle word,
And lay the loud aside.

[Chorus]

[Verse 4]
Now close your eyes, my gentle one,
The house is calm and still;
Heavenly Father helps you choose
Soft words - and always will.

[Chorus]
mood: Cooling music. A warm, slow sway under the voice, like a held breath let out on purpose - the tempo easing a fraction with every verse instead of pushing on. Fingerpicked nylon guitar, rounded and close, with a low sustained warmth beneath it that never sharpens. It starts with a little heat in the phrasing and lets it go, so the last verse sits lower and softer than the first, the way a hot feeling melts rather than breaks.
